topic: Change of Basis in Linear Algebra
target_audience: Undergraduate students in Mathematics, Engineering, or Computer Science

sections.title: Prerequisite & Hook: The 'Same' Vector
lecture_lines: A vector exists independently of its coordinate description.
Think of an arrow as a geometric object.
Changing basis is changing the language of description.
animations: Show a single vector in a 2D plane labeled #FFFFFF 'V'.
Highlight vector V with a bright yellow flash #FFFF00.
Display grid lines #4A4A4A to imply coordinate system.

sections.title: Defining Basis Vectors
lecture_lines: A basis is a system of independent vectors.
Standard basis vectors define our default grid.
Custom basis vectors tilt and stretch the grid.
animations: Show standard basis vectors i^ and j^ #00FF00 over the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Display new basis vectors b1 and b2 #FF00FF.
Connect origins of both sets of vectors with dashed lines.

sections.title: The Change-of-Basis Matrix
lecture_lines: Transition matrix P links different coordinate systems.
P maps new basis back to standard basis.
Standard coordinates equal P times new coordinates.
View vectors as room-centric or claw-centric.
Projection visually maps new components onto standard axes.
animations: Show Matrix P with placeholder entries [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/room.svg] #FFFFFF.
Animate columns of P moving into place.
Scale P by a scalar value for visual emphasis [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/claw.svg] #00FFFF.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Calculation Procedure
lecture_lines: First, identify your new basis vectors.
Second, build matrix P using those vectors.
Third, multiply P by your coordinate vector.
This maps to standard representation efficiently.
Procedure converts any basis to standard coordinates.
animations: Draw a multiplication arrow between P and V [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis & Practical Application
lecture_lines: Change of basis simplifies complex linear problems.
Diagonalization becomes easier with the right basis.
The geometric vector object always stays invariant.

Animate V transforming from original to new basis.
